content.thinking: Nothing seems to have changed, so state-divergence fits well here. My confidence is moderate since the only evidence is the alert itself, which directly records the issue.

hypotheses.summary: The cached per-shopper spend totals stopped keeping up with the purchase ledger at about 19:44Z. The ledger is correct and the cache copies are stale, and nothing is repairing them. The change history, rollout, logs and metrics show no trigger, so what broke cache maintenance (invalidation or update on purchase) is not identified.

supporting_evidence.claim: 90 of 240 cached spend figures disagree with the purchases behind them. The purchases are correct and the cached copies are behind... the oldest purchase none of them account for was recorded at 2026-10-12T19:44:00Z, which is when the copies stopped keeping up.
